extraction.Name: George Menard
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded June 30, 1920 by the First State Bank of Wood
extraction.Buyer: George and Emma Menard conveyed the southeast quarter to George Moore for $1.00 and other valuable consideration; conveyed the other land to Joseph A. Siegmund for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739339 issued; east half of section 35, township 41, range 27; receipt for patent signed by allottee April 7, 1920; southeast quarter conveyed to George Moore on June 28, 1920; remaining land conveyed to Joseph A. Siegmund on July 26, 1920; co-grantor Emma Menard
